Use multiple information streams to determine the state
which a MRI scanner is in.
Reading from any information stream can block reading of
other streams. Use libraries and toolboxes which support
asynchronous operations to circumvent blocks. Basic
information gathering task: Reading log files. Additional
tasks: Reading other systems files, TCP sockets, and writing
to TCP sockets. Each of these tasks is a potential blocking
module to circumvent blocks of any
"thread-friendly" libraries and objects (such as TCP sockets
and their associated libraries and routines) for
Previous implementations leveraged Python's Flask web
application framework, with which we were unable to robustly
implement asynchronous processing of multiple information
streams in combination with publishing scanner's state
information. We reverted to TCP sockets, which interact
more seamlessly and robustly with asynchronous
